thread:
maria: Heads-up — just had a customer report they can see org-level usage and cost breakdown for other teams from the admin console. Not supposed to be visible to their team-level admins.
ajay: yikes. can you paste repro steps? which role are they on?
maria: they are on role=team_admin (should be scoped to their team). repro: login -> Console > Usage -> switch org selector dropdown -> shows other teams and costs. quick curl I ran: `GET /api/v1/usage?org=acme&scope=team` returns full org breakdown.
leo: last week we merged the RBAC roles/permissions refactor (PR #8421) — suspect the org filter got flattened for admin roles.
security-eng: tagging this sev:high until we confirm blast radius. if query returns data across org boundaries that's a PII/authorization bug.
ajay: can someone check audit logs for requests and the permission-check path? want to know when that PR changed the permission check.
audit-bot: audit lookup: no permission-check audit entries found for endpoint `/api/v1/usage` between 1716000000 and 1716240000. Note: audit logging for analytics endpoints was behind feature flag `audit.analytics.enabled` until 1716210000.
maria: that explains missing entries. we toggled that flag to true in staging but apparently not prod.
ops: rolling an emergency flag flip now: `rbacctl set-flag audit.analytics.enabled true --env prod` — will update in 2m.
deploy-bot: Started run: featureflag.toggle(/flags/audit.analytics.enabled) by ops.
ajay: good. after flag is on we should get the missing traces. but we still need a short-term UI fix — hide org selector for team_admins.
leo: agreed. quick patch idea: add an authorization gate in frontend: `if (!hasRole('org_viewer')) hideOrgSelector()` and enforce server side as well. I can open PR for server check.
security-eng: don't rely on frontend. we need server-side authorization hardening + backfill audit logs where possible and a rollback plan. assign if we need to rollback the RBAC refactor.
maria: I spun up a reproducer and captured request/response, attached snippet: ```http
GET /api/v1/usage?org=acme&scope=team HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Response: 200 OK
{"org": "acme", "teams": [{"name":"platform","cost": 1200}, {"name":"mobile","cost": 800} ]}
```
ajay: thanks. leo — can you include the exact permission check we had before? I think we matched `team_id` from JWT to query param. PR #8421 replaced it with a more generic `can_view_usage` claim. maybe incorrectly granted to team_admin.
leo: yep previous check: `if (user.claims.team_id !== query.team_id) deny();` new check: `if (!user.hasPermission('view_usage')) allow();` which is too coarse.
security-eng: plan: 1) ops flips flag (in progress) 2) deploy a hotfix to server to reintroduce team-scoped check for team_admin role 3) backfill audit entries where missing (best-effort) 4) open CVE-style vuln triage doc and notify compliance.
ops: flag flip completed. audit-bot now showing entries for subsequent requests.
audit-bot: audit entry: 1716239602 — /api/v1/usage query by maria (team_admin) returned org-level aggregation.
maria: creating JIRA: SEC-1192 for the RBAC regression + remediation steps, tagging on-call.
security-eng: SEC-1192 created. assign leo to hotfix, ajay to audit/backfill, ops to rollback gating path if needed.
ajay: quick question about KMS — some of the aggregated usage payloads include billing ids encrypted at rest. do we need to rotate KMS keys or generate a new DEK for the backfilled logs? compliance might ask.
security-eng: contact compliance. for now, treat backfilled logs as PII-sensitive: encrypt with current KMS key and log rotation note in SEC-1192. if key rotation is needed we can re-encrypt.
leo: I'm pushing a server-side hotfix branch `fix/rbac-usage-scope` — small change to `usageService.authorizeRequest()` to ensure team_id scoping for team_admin. will open PR and request urgent review.
maria: can we add a temporary audit tag `incident:SEC-1192` on all affected entries for searchability?
ajay: yep we can append `meta.incident=SEC-1192` during backfill job. I'll run backfill after PR merges.
ops: rolling deploy of hotfix to prod in 10m. I'll monitor SLOs.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: hotfix/fix-rbac-usage-scope -> prod by ops.
security-eng: once deployed, run the exploit script and validate unauthorized views are blocked. also update runbook with lessons (missing flag, coarse permission mapping).
maria: noted. capturing repro commands in SEC-1192. thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
